usage_notes: Use SiApachespark, SiApachehadoop, SiMysql, and SiScikitlearn from react-icons/si for the cleanest tech stack representation.
The hero images are cropped to 1200x400 to match dashboard requirements while preserving subject focus.
The data node backgrounds work best as full-page washes or section dividers with low opacity overlays.
